title: Spatial Intents
description: Spatial Intents v2 (spec section 7): landmarks, the standard intent catalog, ResolvedPlacement audit records, the -32005 error data, and the `resolveSpatial` dry-run request. Anchors are defined in game-rl.schema.json#/$defs/Anchor.

Landmark.description: Named, stable spatial reference exposed in observations for use as an anchor (REQ-SPA-04). Minimum set: ColonyCenter (or AgentCenter), MapCenter, and the eight compass-region centroids Region_N ... Region_NW.

Kind.description: Landmark category: Centroid (computed center), Region (compass region), Cluster (resource/terrain cluster), Feature (map feature), Zone (named zone), Building (named building)

Position.description: Landmark position (centroid for regions, zones, and clusters)

Label.description: Human-readable label, when distinct from Id

CellCount.description: Number of cells in the landmark (clusters and regions)

Fertility.description: Mean soil fertility of the landmark's cells (fertile-terrain clusters)

PlaceBuildingNear.description: Spatial intent: place one or more buildings near an anchor

Near.description: Anchor to place near (any anchor grammar form, REQ-SPA-01)

AllowFallback.description: If true, the environment MAY relocate when the anchor is infeasible and MUST then set FallbackApplied: true; if false (default), infeasible placement fails with error -32005 (REQ-SPA-02)

EstablishFarm.description: Spatial intent: create a growing zone near an anchor

Near.description: Anchor to place the farm near (any anchor grammar form, REQ-SPA-01)

Crop.description: Crop to plant (e.g. 'Rice', 'Potatoes'); environment default when omitted

AllowFallback.description: If true, the environment MAY relocate when the anchor is infeasible and MUST then set FallbackApplied: true; if false (default), infeasible placement fails with error -32005 (REQ-SPA-02)

EstablishStorage.description: Spatial intent: create a storage/stockpile zone near an anchor

Near.description: Anchor to place the storage near (any anchor grammar form, REQ-SPA-01)

AllowFallback.description: If true, the environment MAY relocate when the anchor is infeasible and MUST then set FallbackApplied: true; if false (default), infeasible placement fails with error -32005 (REQ-SPA-02)

DesignateMiningNear.description: Spatial intent: designate mineable cells near an anchor

Near.description: Anchor to mine near (any anchor grammar form, REQ-SPA-01)

AllowFallback.description: If true, the environment MAY relocate when the anchor is infeasible and MUST then set FallbackApplied: true; if false (default), infeasible placement fails with error -32005 (REQ-SPA-02)

DesignateClearNear.description: Spatial intent: designate vegetation/debris clearing near an anchor

Near.description: Anchor to clear around (any anchor grammar form, REQ-SPA-01)

AllowFallback.description: If true, the environment MAY relocate when the anchor is infeasible and MUST then set FallbackApplied: true; if false (default), infeasible placement fails with error -32005 (REQ-SPA-02)

SpatialIntent.description: Any standard-catalog spatial intent (spec section 7.7). Games SHOULD reuse these names for analogous semantics so cross-game policies transfer.

ResolvedPlacement.description: Audit record returned for every successful spatial intent (REQ-SPA-06), inline in the step result or as the Feedback/structured payload

Description.description: Human-readable account of the resolution (e.g. 'Placed 3 Beds near Stockpile_4821 at (42,13), (44,13), (46,13)')

AnchorRequested.description: The anchor exactly as the agent requested it

AnchorResolved.description: The concrete anchor instance the intent resolved to (e.g. 'Stockpile_4821'); MUST correspond to AnchorRequested unless FallbackApplied is true (REQ-SPA-02)

FallbackApplied.description: True when the environment relocated away from the requested anchor (only permitted with AllowFallback: true)

MeanDistanceToAnchor.description: Mean distance in cells from the placements to the resolved anchor

SpatialError.description: The `data` payload of JSON-RPC error -32005 (Spatial resolution failed, spec section 7.5). When any feasible placement exists, Alternatives MUST list at least one feasible anchor (REQ-SPA-02).

AnchorRequested.description: The anchor exactly as the agent requested it

Alternatives.description: Feasible alternative anchors the agent could request instead

Anchor.description: Anchor identifier the agent could request (e.g. 'FertileCluster_0')

Reason.description: Why this alternative is feasible (e.g. '190 fertile cells, fertility 1.4')

request.description: Arguments for `resolveSpatial` (REQ-SPA-05): read-only dry run returning the ResolvedPlacement that would result (or the -32005 error), without mutating state

Intent.description: The spatial intent to resolve, identical in shape to the corresponding `step` action
